title: Events calendar | | wvnews.com
text:
Saturday, Nov. 8
West Virginia Storytelling Guild Youth Storytelling Workshop, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Frank and Jane Gabor West Virginia Folklife Center on the campus of Fairmont State University.
Saturday, Nov. 8
West Virginia Storytelling Guild Youth Storytelling Workshop, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Frank and Jane Gabor West Virginia Folklife Center on the campus of Fairmont State University.
Tuesday, Nov. 11
Veterans Day Parade down Main Street, Buckhannon, with activities afterward in Jawbone Park. Parade lineup begins at 8:30 a.m.
Tuesday, Nov. 18
Buckhannon Rotary Night of Inspiration, 6-8 p.m., Chapel Hill United Methodist Church, Buckhannon.
Saturday, Nov. 22
Holly Jolly Craft Show, Event Center, Brushy Fork.
Thursday, Nov. 27
Upshur County Recreational Complex 5K, 7:30 a.m., beginning at Jawbone Park, Buckhannon.
Dec. 4-7
Buckhannon Community Theatre presents “Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer Jr.” in the Colonial Arts Center.
Friday Dec. 5
Buckhannon Fire Department Christmas parade, 6 p.m., down Main Street. Santa Claus will visit Fire Department following parade.
Saturday, Dec. 6
Holiday FURtastic Elimination Dinner, 6 p.m., Event Center at Brushy Fork.
Sunday, Dec. 14
Annual Menorah Lighting, 7 p.m., Jawbone Park, Buckhannon.
Upcoming Robinson Grand Performing Arts Center main events: Tickets for these events can be ordered at: https://tickets.therobinsongrand.com/
A Motown Christmas, Sunday, Dec. 14, 4 p.m.
